```http
POST /v1/emails
```

Send from your server only. Use one `Idempotency-Key` per logical event and reuse it on every retry of that event. Template sends need scope `emails:send`; raw sends (no `template`, a `subject` and `html` and/or `text`) need `emails:send_raw`. The request body may be up to 6 MiB as shipped (attachments).

## Authentication

Send a server-side API key: `Authorization: Bearer $NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY`. See [Authentication](/docs/authentication).

Required scope: `emails:send` or `emails:send_raw`.

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string | yes | One per logical application event (one OTP, one reset). Reuse it on every retry of that event; use a new one for a new event. pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}$`. |

## Request body

Content type: `application/json`. Required.

Unknown fields are rejected with 422 invalid_request. (Not expressed as additionalProperties:false because a batch item adds idempotency_key to these fields.)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | no | An approved sender identity for the key's project and environment. Required, unless the template pins a default sender. |
| `to` | string | yes | One recipient (bare address). Together with cc and bcc at most 10 addresses. |
| `template` | string | no | A built-in template (otp, password-reset, account-notice, notification) or one published for the project. Omit it for a raw send. |
| `template_version` | integer | no | Omit it to use the newest published version. minimum 1. |
| `locale` | string | no | A language tag such as en or sw (Kiswahili); your own templates can use others such as fr. Missing content falls back to English. default `"en"`. pattern `^[A-Za-z]{2,3}([-_][A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})?$`. |
| `variables` | object | no | otp: name?, code (4-12 letters or digits), expires_in_minutes (1-60). password-reset: name?, reset_url (https, origin approved for the environment), expires_in_minutes (1-1440). account-notice: name?, title (&lt;=100, single line), message (&lt;=1000). notification: title (&lt;=150), name?, message? (&lt;=2000), details? (a list of &#123;label, value&#125; rows or an object of label: value; up to 30 rows, values &lt;=500), action_url? (https, approved origin), action_label? (&lt;=40), footer? (&lt;=500), app_name? (&lt;=60), preheader? (&lt;=150). HTML is escaped. |
| `ttl_seconds` | integer | no | Submission will not start after this. Auth templates default 300 (max 900); notices default 3600 (max 86400). minimum 30. |
| `metadata` | object | no | no other fields. |
| `metadata.request_id` | string | no | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$`. |
| `subject` | string | no | Raw send only (scope emails:send_raw). |
| `html` | string | no | Raw send only. |
| `text` | string | no | Raw send only. |
| `reply_to` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `cc` | array of string | no | &nbsp; |
| `bcc` | array of string | no | &nbsp; |
| `priority` | "high" \| "normal" | no | otp and password-reset default to high. |
| `send_at` | string (date-time) | no | RFC 3339, at most 7 days ahead. |
| `web_view` | boolean | no | Adds a "view in browser" link at the top of the message, backed by a signed copy of the HTML that expires after 30 days. Not allowed with priority high (one-time codes, password resets). |
| `attachments` | array of object | no | at most 5 items. |
| `attachments[].filename` | string | yes | &nbsp; |
| `attachments[].content_type` | "application/pdf" \| "image/png" \| "image/jpeg" \| "text/plain" | yes | &nbsp; |
| `attachments[].content` | string (byte) | yes | Standard base64. At most 5 files and 5 MiB in total. |
| `headers` | map of string to string | no | &nbsp; |

Example:

```json
{
  "from": "noreply@notify.example.com",
  "to": "user@example.org",
  "template": "otp",
  "locale": "en",
  "variables": {
    "name": "Ada",
    "code": "482913",
    "expires_in_minutes": 5
  },
  "metadata": {
    "request_id": "login-7f3a"
  }
}
```

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

const res = await fetch(`${process.env.NJIWA_MAIL_URL}/v1/emails`, {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY}`,

    "Content-Type": "application/json",

    },
    "metadata": {
      "request_id": "login-7f3a"
    }
  }),
});
if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Njiwa-Mail ${res.status}: ${await res.text()}`);
console.log(await res.json());

<Tab value="Go">

```go
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	body := []byte(`{"from":"noreply@notify.example.com","to":"user@example.org","template":"otp","locale":"en","variables":{"name":"Ada","code":"482913","expires_in_minutes":5},"metadata":{"request_id":"login-7f3a"}}`)
	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_URL")+"/v1/emails", bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY"))
	b := make([]byte, 16)
	_, _ = rand.Read(b)
	req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "req:"+hex.EncodeToString(b)) // reuse it when you retry
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	out, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
	fmt.Println(res.StatusCode, string(out))
}
```

Keys belong on your server: never put them in a browser, a mobile app, a URL or a log.

## Responses

### 202

Durably queued (`queued`, or `scheduled` when `send_at` is in the future), or an identical replay (the original id).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (uuid) | yes | &nbsp; |
| `status` | "queued" \| "scheduled" \| "submitting" \| "submitted" \| "retry_wait" \| "failed" \| "unknown" \| "expired" \| "captured" \| "cancelled" | yes | queued or scheduled for a new message; the current state for an identical replay. |

```json
{
  "id": "6f1c2d0e-3b52-4d49-9a43-7d1f0c5e8a11",
  "status": "queued"
}
```

### 401

invalid_api_key. The response carries `WWW-Authenticate`.

Header `WWW-Authenticate`: string

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

### 403

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ip_not_allowed"
  }
}
```

### 409

idempotency_conflict: the same key was used with a different body

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "idempotency_conflict"
  }
}
```

### 413

body_too_large

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "body_too_large"
  }
}
```

### 422

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "idempotency_key_invalid"
  }
}
```

### 429

rate_limited (a project quota, or the installation-wide or per-sending-domain Live limit). Wait `Retry-After` seconds and retry with the same key.

Header `Retry-After`: integer

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "monthly_quota_exceeded"
  }
}
```

### 503

service_unavailable or queue_full. Nothing was accepted. Retry with the same key after `Retry-After`.

Header `Retry-After`: integer

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "queue_full"
  }
}
```

## Error codes

Errors share one shape: `error.code` is stable, `error.message` is optional detail. Retry only timeouts, network errors, `429` and `5xx`, with the same idempotency key; fix the request for every other `4xx`.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | Missing, wrong, revoked or expired key |
| `ip_not_allowed` | 403 | The caller's address is not on the key's allowlist |
| `missing_scope` | 403 | The key lacks the scope this call needs |
| `sender_not_approved` | 403 | `from` is not an approved, enabled sender for this key's environment |
| `sender_not_allowed` | 403 | This API key is limited to other senders |
| `project_disabled` | 403 | The operator disabled the project or environment |
| `domain_not_registered` | 403 | Live: the sender's domain is not a sending domain of this project |
| `domain_claimed_elsewhere` | 403 | Live: another project holds the domain, or it awaits operator review |
| `domain_not_ready` | 403 | Live: ownership, SPF, DKIM or DMARC does not pass yet |
| `idempotency_conflict` | 409 | Same key, different body |
| `idempotency_key_invalid` | 422 | The key is not 8 to 128 characters of `A-Za-z0-9._:-` |
| `invalid_request` | 422 | Unreadable JSON, unknown field, or a missing required field |
| `invalid_recipient` | 422 | A recipient is not a valid address |
| `invalid_sender` | 422 | `from` is not a valid address |
| `unknown_template` | 422 | No such template (or version) for this project |
| `invalid_locale` | 422 | `locale` is not a language tag such as `en`, `sw`, `fr` or `pt-br` |
| `invalid_ttl` | 422 | `ttl_seconds` is outside the allowed range |
| `invalid_metadata` | 422 | `metadata` has a field other than `request_id`, or a bad value |
| `invalid_priority` | 422 | `priority` is not `high` or `normal` |
| `invalid_send_at` | 422 | Not RFC 3339, in the past, or more than 7 days ahead |
| `web_view_not_allowed` | 422 | `web_view` with priority `high`: a one-time code or reset link must not live on at a URL |
| `invalid_header` | 422 | An extra header is not allowed |
| `invalid_attachment` | 422 | Bad base64, a disallowed type, or content that does not match the type |
| `too_many_attachments` | 422 | More than 5 attachments |
| `attachments_too_large` | 422 | A file or the total is over 5 MiB |
| `too_many_recipients` | 422 | More than 10 addresses in `to`, `cc` and `bcc` |
| `recipient_suppressed` | 422 | The address is suppressed (for example after a hard bounce) |
| `recipient_unsubscribed` | 422 | The recipient unsubscribed from this kind of mail |
| `recipient_not_allowed` | 422 | Live: the recipient is not on the operator's allowlist |
| `monthly_quota_exceeded` | 429 | Live: the project's monthly message quota (its usage plan) is used up. `Retry-After` points to the next month (UTC) |
| `unknown_variable` | 422 | `variables` has a name the template does not declare |
| `missing_variable` | 422 | A variable the template requires is missing |
| `invalid_variable_type` | 422 | A variable has the wrong JSON type |
| `invalid_variable_format` | 422 | A variable does not match its format (for example a code with other characters) |
| `variable_too_long` | 422 | A variable is longer than its limit, or a `details` list has too many rows |
| `variable_out_of_range` | 422 | A number is outside its allowed range (for example `expires_in_minutes`) |
| `invalid_characters` | 422 | A variable contains characters that are not allowed (such as line breaks in a title) |
| `invalid_url` | 422 | A URL variable is not a valid `https` URL |
| `url_origin_not_approved` | 422 | A URL's origin is not approved for this environment (`njiwa-mail env origins`) |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | A limit was reached. See `Retry-After` |
| `queue_full` | 503 | The live backlog is full. See `Retry-After` |
| `service_unavailable` | 503 | Storage was unavailable. Nothing was accepted |

Every code is explained on [Rate limits and errors](/docs/api/rate-limits-and-errors).
